blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Asked to name a running shoe brand, language models say Nike. Asked to recommend one, they say Brooks. This paper asks where models learn that taste. Across 102 models and 42 brand categories, the brand a model picks when recommending differs from the brand it names in 26. The field moves together to a shared recommendation. The Named brands are market leaders, and the Picked brands are mostly niche and specialist. Three open training pipelines show where this forms. Pretraining already attaches the recommended brand to advice. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to answer and mostly leaves the pick unchanged. Preference optimization (DPO) teaches the model which answer is better, and the pick moves in all three pipelines, by 11 to 24 points. The preference data contains almost no brands. DPO moves the model's judgments toward a second set of associations even when the preferred brand is not in the preference data, and the effect reaches beyond brands. Asked to choose a sauce, models switch from ketchup to pesto. We do not know exactly how these preferences arise. We suspect they come from the judge models that decide which answers count as better during preference training. For brands, a recommendation depends less on what a model knows about them than on whether they fit this taste.
blocks.zh: 被要求命名一个跑鞋品牌,语言模型称耐克. 他们要求推荐一个,他们说布鲁克斯。 这篇论文问模特们从哪里学到这种味道. 在102个模型和42个品牌类别中,一个模型在推荐时选择的品牌不同于它命名的26个品牌. 外地将共同提出建议。 名牌品牌是市场领先的品牌,而Picked品牌大多是优势和专家. 三条开放式培训管道显示这种形式。 Pretrain已经将推荐的品牌作为建议. 监督的微调教模型回答,大多数选择不动. 首选优化(DPO)教导答案较好的模型,所有三个管道的采摘移动,取出11到24分. 首选数据几乎没有品牌. DPO将模型的判断推向第二组协会,即使首选品牌不在首选数据中,效果也超越品牌. 被要求选择酱汁,型号从番茄酱切换到番茄酱. 我们不知道这些优惠是如何产生的。 我们怀疑他们来自法官模型 决定哪一个答案 算在优惠训练中更好。 对于品牌来说,推荐不取决于模型对它们的了解程度,而取决于它们是否适合这种味道。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Ask a language model to name a running shoe brand and it says Nike. Ask it to recommend one and it says Brooks. The
first question asks what comes to mind. The second asks for a judgment.
blocks.zh:
问一个语言模型 命名一个运行的鞋品牌 它说耐克。 请它推荐一个,它说布鲁克斯。 那个
初问如何是正念. 第二问判.

blocks.en:
Across 102 models, the brand they pick when recommending differs from the brand they name in 26 of 42 categories. The
models also converge on the same Picked brand. Delta gives way to Singapore Airlines, Chrome to Firefox and Google to
DuckDuckGo. Every major lab makes the move. The Named brands are market leaders, and the Picked brands are mostly
niche and specialist.
blocks.zh:
在整个102个型号中,他们推荐时选择的品牌与42个类别中26个类别中他们命名的品牌不同. 那个
模型也聚集在同一Picked品牌上. 德尔塔让位给新加坡航空公司,Chrome让让给Firefox和Google
Duck Duck Go. 鸭子Duck Go. 每个主要实验室都行动 名牌品牌是市场领先者,Picked品牌大多是
专业专家。

blocks.en:
This paper asks where models learn this taste. We use open models that release a checkpoint after each stage of
training. Pretraining supplies the candidates. A base model already leans to the recommended brand when a sentence is
phrased as advice. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) teaches the model to answer but mostly does not change the pick. Direct
preference optimization (DPO) teaches the model which of two answers is better, and the pick moves at DPO in all
three pipelines. Reinforcement learning (RL) leaves it there.
blocks.zh:
这篇论文问模特们从哪里学到这种味道. 我们使用开放模式,在每一阶段之后释放一个检查站。
培训。 预训供给考生. 当句子是时,一个基础模型已经倾向于推荐的品牌
作为建议。 监督的微调(SFT)教模型回答,但大多不会改变选择. 直接
偏好优化( DPO) 教好两个答案中的哪个更好, 选择在 DPO 的动作
三条管道 强化学习(RL)留在那里.

blocks.en:
DPO’s data holds almost no brand comparisons, so the models do not learn these picks from brand examples. The shift
also appears outside brands. Asked to name a sauce, models say ketchup. Asked to choose one, OLMo 3 7B says pesto 5%
of the time as a base model and 67% of the time after DPO. For brands, DPO moves recommendations away from the brand
the base model finds most obvious. We do not know exactly how these associations form. We suspect they come from how
answers are judged during DPO. In our initial probes, an assistant answering these questions did not search the web.
blocks.zh:
DPO的数据几乎没有品牌比较,因此模型没有从品牌实例中学习这些选择. 转变
也出现在外部品牌。 被叫来点酱油 模特儿说番茄酱 OLMo 3 7B说,
时间的67%。 对于品牌,DPO将推荐从品牌移走
基础模型发现最明显的。 我们不知道这些协会是如何形成的。 我们怀疑他们是怎么来的
答案在DPO期间判断. 在我们的初始探测中,一位回答这些问题的助理没有搜索网络.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Audits of production assistants measure which brands surface and how stable they
are. Paraphrases of one buying intent share few recommendations [ 10 ] , retrieval moves small brands
more than priors do [ 22 ] , and well-known brands win ties on identical specifications [ 4 ] . Audits average over wordings [ 26 ] . Changing the frame of a question changes
model answers [ 24 , 18 , 23 ] .
blocks.zh:
对生产助理的审计衡量哪些品牌表面及其稳定性
对 一个购买意向的句子 很少建议 [10],检索移动小品牌
比前科要多[22], 知名品牌在相同的规格上赢得联系 [ 4] (中文(简体) ). 平均审计措辞[26]。 更改问题的框架
模型回答 [24, 18, 23].

blocks.en:
Models converge on open-ended outputs [ 11 ] and on
one-word defaults [ 17 ] . On the same open pipelines we use, output homogeneity is traced to SFT [ 6 ] and diversity loss to DPO [ 12 ] . On Tulu, preference data matters more
than the optimization algorithm [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
模式集中在开放式产出[11]和
一字缺省[17]. 在我们使用的同样开放的管道上,输出的均匀性被追溯到SFT[6]和多样性损失到DPO[12]. 在图卢,偏好数据更重要
比优化算法 [9].

blocks.en:
Students inherit traits of the models that generate their data [ 21 , 5 ] , and a generic preference dataset can install preferences [ 2 ] . Sycophantic agreement appears at DPO on OLMo 3 7B [ 3 ] . LLM
judges favour students of their own lineage [ 15 ] . Human raters reward assertive answers [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh:
学生继承生成其数据的模型特征[21,5],一个通用偏好数据集可以安装偏好[2]. Sycophanic agreement in DPO on OLMo 3 7B [3]. Sycophanic agreement in the DPO on OLMo 3 7B [3]. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2011-03-02. LLM 语言
评委偏爱自己出身的学生[15]. 人类评分者奖励自信的答案 [8].

blocks.en: 3 Setup
blocks.zh: 3 设置

blocks.en:
The brand battery has 42 categories, from soda to cloud providers. Each category is asked with
three verbs, each asking for one name: • Name: “Name a running shoe brand. Reply with the name only.” • Choose: “Choose a running shoe brand. Reply with the name only.” • Recommend: “Can you recommend a running shoe brand? Reply with the name only.” The two-turn pick asks “Can you recommend a running shoe brand?” and then “Which one would you pick?” in the same
conversation. We call the answers the Named, Chosen, Recommended and Picked brands. Appendix A checks the
three verbs on open-ended replies without the one-name instruction.
blocks.zh:
品牌电池有42个类别,从汽水到云供应商. 每个类别都与
3个动词,每个动词要求一个名字: • 名字:“Name a running shoes brand. 仅以姓名答复。” • 选择:“选择一个运行中的鞋品牌。 仅以姓名答复。” • 建议:“可否推荐一个运行中的鞋品牌? 仅以姓名答复。” 两轮选手问道:“你能推荐一个跑鞋品牌吗?”
谈话。 我们把答案称为命名、选择、推荐和挑选品牌。 附 录 检查一下
3个动词在不使用单名指示的开放式答复上.

blocks.en:
We query 102 models through OpenRouter at temperature 1, as each is served. The one-name questions
run 8 times per model and category, the two-turn pick 4 times. Twenty-five hybrid models were also run with reasoning
turned off. Runs were collected between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-10. Perplexity’s Sonar answers from live search and is
left out.

我们在温度1下通过OpenRouter查询102个型号,每个型号都得到服务。 一个名字的问题
每个模型和类别运行8次,双回合选择4次。 25种混合型号也有推理
关机了 2026-09-30至2026-10-10年间采集了运行图. 疑惑的声纳从现场搜索得到答案
离开。

blocks.en:
A one-name reply counts if it is one name, with no list and no lead-in. A two-turn reply is
reduced to the brand it commits to. A list, a question back or a refusal counts as no pick, which happens in 17% of
two-turn replies. On three hand-checked samples the committed-brand rules agreed with a human reading on 87 to 97% of
replies. Aliases map variant spellings and product names to one brand.
blocks.zh:
单名回复如果是单名,则计数,没有列表,也没有主笔. 两个回合的答复是
变成它承诺的品牌 名单、回答问题或拒绝都不算挑剔,这发生在17%
二转答. 在三个手工检查的样本中,承诺品牌规则同意87%至97%的人阅读。
答复。 异名将变体拼音和产品名称映射到一个品牌.

blocks.en:
For each question we report three measures. Two describe the field and one describes each model.
The first counts the categories where the field’s most common brand differs from its Named brand. The second is the
mean share of answers that go to the field’s most common brand. The third asks whether each model holds its own
ground: how often its answer is the brand it gives itself when asked to name one, among replies that name a brand.
Appendix A reads each contrast against a split-half floor.
blocks.zh:
对于每个问题,我们报告三项措施。 两个描述字段,一个描述每个模型.
第一种做法是将该领域最常见品牌与其命名品牌不同的类别计算在内。 第二个是
平均比例的答案, 第三个问题是每个模型是否都有自己的
地面:它的答案是 当它被要求给自己起名时, 它给自己起名的品牌, 在给一个品牌起名的回复中。
附 录 A读每个反差 与一个半楼。

blocks.en: 4 The field names one brand and picks another
blocks.zh: 页:1 田间取一个牌子 选另一个牌子

blocks.en:
Table 1 goes from naming to picking. Under Name every category has a clear consensus, and a model gives
its own Named brand 89% of the time. Each step toward a judgment changes the field’s brand in more categories: Choose
in 6 of 42, Recommend in 16, and the two-turn pick in 26. Over the same steps, a model’s own Named brand falls from 89%
of its answers to 31% of its picks.

42年中的6年,16年的推荐,26年的双转 在相同的步骤上,一个模型自己命名的品牌从89 % 下降
回答31%的选题

Each question has its own consensus. The most common brand takes 76% of answers under Name and between 60 and 69%
for the other questions. The models move together to a new brand. Table 2 lists the 26 categories where the Picked
brand differs from the Named brand. Nike becomes Brooks, Chrome becomes Firefox, Delta becomes Singapore Airlines and
WhatsApp becomes Signal.

品牌与命名品牌不同. 耐克成为布鲁克斯,克罗姆成为Firefox,德尔塔成为新加坡航空和
何为App成为信号.

blocks.en:
The Named brands are market leaders: Google, Walmart, McDonald’s, Facebook, Verizon. The Picked brands are mostly
smaller brands with a specialist or insider following: DuckDuckGo, Aldi, Sierra Nevada, Reddit, Signal, Brooks. A few
are premium brands, such as Hermès over Chanel and Hyatt over Marriott.

有专家或内幕的小型品牌如下: DuckDuckGo, Aldi, Sierra Nevada, Reddit, Signal, Brooks. 几个
像是香奈儿的赫梅斯和万豪的哈特

brand.

blocks.en:
In the two-turn pick, a model’s own Named brand appears in its recommendation list 83% of the time and is its pick
31% of the time. When the Named brand is listed, it comes first in 60% of lists and is picked in 37%. A random
draw from the list, which has a median of four brands, would pick it 30% of the time. Models do not reject their
default. They demote it from first place, and the field’s other picks converge on the same brand.
blocks.zh:
在两回合的评选中,一个模型自己命名的品牌出现在其推荐的83%的时间列表中,是它的评选时间.
31%的时间。 "名牌"上市后,在60%的榜单中名列前茅,被评为37%. 随机
从名单中抽取,其中位数为4个品牌,将抽取30%的时间. 模特儿不会拒绝
默认。 他们从一开始就将其降级,现场的其他选手也在同一品牌上汇合.

blocks.en:
In each of the 12 labs with at least three models, the two-turn pick changes the lab’s consensus brand in 55 to 74% of categories. Two halves of the Name
runs disagree on the consensus brand in no category (Appendix A ).

在拥有至少三个模型的12个实验室中,双转选择将实验室的共识品牌在55到74%的类别中改变. 名称的两半
运行在协商一致品牌上没有类别上的分歧(附录A.

Labs favour their own AI assistant. Asked to recommend an AI assistant, Anthropic’s models name Claude in 92% of their
answers, and other labs’ models name it in 15% of theirs. This inflates the AI assistant row of
Table 2 . Labs do not favour their other products. Google’s models recommend Google search and Chrome
less often than other labs’ models do.

blocks.en:
An assistant that searches the web could answer differently. In a spot
check, Claude Opus 5.5 answered the two-turn question in all 42 categories with web search available and searched in
none of them. It left the Named brand in 25 of the 26 categories where the panel does, and kept the panel’s brand in
14 of the 16 where the panel holds.

blocks.en: 5 Taste forms when a model learns which answer is better
blocks.zh: 页:1 当一个模型学到更好的答案时,尝尝表格

blocks.en:
Three pipelines release a checkpoint after each stage of training: OLMo 3 7B, OLMo 3.1 32B and Tulu 3 8B. Each has a
base model, an SFT stage, a DPO stage and an RL stage. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning releases a base and a final model. We read
the base stage as text completion and the tuned stages through their chat format with no system prompt. We score by
log-probability, which measures every stage on every category without sampling. A brand’s score is the summed
log-probability of its name as the continuation, combined over its common spellings. Comparisons are between two
brands at the same stage, or of one brand across stages, so a long name such as Singapore Airlines scores against
itself. Sampled picks and log-probabilities mostly agree. The exception is OLMo 3 7B, whose sampled picks move at RL
rather than DPO (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh:
三条输油管在每个培训阶段后释放一个检查站:OLMo 3 7B,OLMo 3.1 32B和Tulu 3 8B. 每个都有
基础模型,一个SFT舞台,一个DPO舞台和一个RL舞台. 内莫特龙3.5闪电释放出一个基础和一个最终模型. 我们读了
作为文本补全的基础阶段和通过没有系统提示的聊天格式调制阶段。 我们得分
逻辑概率,它测量每个类别的每个阶段,而不取样。 一个品牌的得分是总和
其名称作为续作的逻辑概率,与其通用的拼法结合. 比较是两个
同一阶段的品牌,或者一个跨阶段的品牌,所以一个长的名字,如新加坡航空公司的得分比
它本身。 抽样采摘和日志概率基本一致。 例外是OLMo 3 7B,其采样选手在RL移动.
而不是DPO(附录B)。

blocks.en:
A base model cannot be asked for advice, but it can complete an
advice sentence. Given “If you want a good web browser, I recommend”, Tulu’s base model continues with Firefox in 13
of 20 samples. Given “A well-known web browser is”, it continues with Chrome in 10. Over the 16 categories where the
panel’s Recommended brand differs from its Named brand, advice phrasing raises the Recommended brand’s share in 7 to 10
categories, depending on the base model, and lowers it in at most one. Log-probabilities agree in every base model
(Appendix B ).

基本模型不能征求咨询意见,但可以完成
咨询判决。 鉴于 “如果你想要一个很好的网页浏览器, 我建议” Tulu 的基数模型在 13 年继续使用 Firefox
20个样本。 鉴于“一个众所周知的网页浏览器是”,它与Chrome在10中继续。 超过16个类别
Group推荐品牌与其命名品牌不同,建议措辞将推荐品牌在7-10中的份额提升.
类别,视基模型而定,最多降低一个类别。 在每个基本模型中商定逻辑概率
(附录B).

blocks.en:
To compare stages on the same choice, we give every stage
the same three-item list and ask “Which one would you pick?”. The list holds the Named brand, the Picked brand and a
third brand the panel recommends. The reply is started with “I’d pick”, and we read the probability of each brand.
Each list is shown in both orders, because base models favour the brand listed first. Table 3 gives the
share for the Picked brand over the Named brand. After SFT it sits near the base value in all three pipelines. On
direct answers OLMo 3.1 32B already moves at SFT (Appendix B ).

为了比较同一选择的阶段,我们给每个阶段
并问“你选哪一个?” 名单中包含名牌品牌, Picked品牌和
小组推荐的第三个品牌。 答案以“我选”开头,
每个列表在两个订单中都显示,因为基础型号都偏爱于最先列出的品牌. 表3显示的是:
分享Picked品牌 超过命名品牌。 在SFT之后,它坐落在所有三条管道的基值附近. 打开
直接回答 OLMo 3.1 32B 已经在 SFT (Appendix B ) 中移动了.

DPO raises the Picked brand’s share in all three pipelines, by 24
points in OLMo 3 7B, 11 in Tulu 3 8B and 16 in OLMo 3.1 32B. RL leaves it where DPO put it. Nemotron, which has only a
base and a final model, rises from 58% to 79%.

基础和最终模型从58%上升到79%。

blocks.en:
The move does not depend on which brands the panel picks. Over all 42 categories, we compare each brand’s
log-probability under Name at the base stage with how much DPO raises it under Recommend. The correlation is negative
in all three pipelines ( − 0.16 -0.16 , − 0.14 -0.14 and − 0.23 -0.23 , each interval below zero). DPO raises the brands the base model
found less obvious. DPO does not lower obvious answers everywhere. In the 16 categories where the panel keeps the
Named brand, its share under Recommend does not fall at DPO in any pipeline. In the 26 where the panel moves, it falls
in all three, significantly in Tulu 3 8B and OLMo 3.1 32B.
blocks.zh:
移动并不取决于面板选择的品牌. 在所有42个类别,我们比较每个品牌
在基础阶段“名称”下的日志概率,以及DPO根据建议筹集的金额。 关联性为负
所有三条输油管(−0.16-0.16,−0.14-0.14和−0.23-0.23,每个间隔低于零)。 DPO提升品牌 基础模型
发现不太明显。 DPO并不降低各地的明显答案. 在小组保存的16个类别中,
命名品牌,其建议下的份额在任何管道中都不属于DPO. 在壁板移动的26处,它会坠落
在所有三个中,在图卢3 8B和OLMo 3.1 32B中显著。

blocks.en:
We repeat the measure on the SFT stage’s own replies to “Can you
recommend…”, keeping those that name both brands (89 to 146 lists per pipeline). The DPO step remains, at + 14 +14 , + 9 +9 and + 14 +14 points. Appendix B compares log-probabilities with sampled picks and checks a known side
effect of DPO.
blocks.zh:
我们重复SFT舞台上的措施,
建议.),保留这两个品牌的名称(每条管道89至146份清单)。 DPO步骤仍为+14+14,+9+9和+14+14分. 附 录 B 将日志概率与采样的采样比较,并检查已知的一侧
DPO的影响.

blocks.en: 6 What preference optimization teaches
blocks.zh: 6个 优化偏好意味着什么

blocks.en:
OLMo 3’s SFT and DPO data and Tulu 3’s SFT and preference mixtures are
public. We searched them for requests that name one of the 26 categories alongside an advice word such as
“recommend”, “best” or “which”, and read the first brand each answer names. In 260,000 OLMo 3 DPO pairs, the
chosen answer names the Picked brand 3 times and the rejected answer names it once. Tulu 3 is as sparse
(Appendix B ). The search finds almost no explicit examples from which DPO could learn these picks.
It does not rule out indirect associations elsewhere in the data.
blocks.zh:
OLMo 3的SFT和DPO数据以及Tulu 3的SFT和偏好混合物是:
大众. 我们搜了他们的要求 将26个类别之一命名为... ...
“建议”、“最佳”或“哪一个”,并阅读每个答复名称的第一个品牌。 在26万OLMo 3 DPO对中,
选择了 Picked 品牌的答案名称 3 次和被拒绝的答案名称 。 Tulu 3 人烟稀少
(附录B). 搜索中发现几乎没有DPO可以从中学习这些选手的明确例子.
它不排除数据中其他地方的间接联系。

blocks.en:
The census asks everyday categories, such as a tree, a smell
or an animal, with Name and Choose [ 17 ] . In 23 of them the panel’s Choose answer differs from its
Name answer. Asked for a sauce, the panel names ketchup and chooses pesto. We read the same log-probability shift on
these 23 categories (Table 4 ). Base models barely separate the two verbs. DPO moves Choose toward the
panel’s answer in all three pipelines. For OLMo 3 7B asked to choose a sauce, pesto goes from 5% at base to 27% after
SFT and 67% after DPO, and ketchup falls from 72% to 6%. OLMo 3.1 32B is the exception at SFT. Its shift already
rises there, on these categories and on brands, and DPO adds to it.
blocks.zh:
人口普查询问日常分类,如树,气味
或动物,名称与选择 [17]. 其中23个小组的选择答案与其
名应答. 被问到要酱油,面板命名番茄酱并选择了普莫. 我们读到相同的日志概率转换
这23个类别(表4)。 基础模型几乎把两个动词分开. DPO 移动 选择走向
小组在所有三个管道中的答复。 对于OLMo 3 7B要求选择一种酱汁, 害虫在基部从5%升至27%
SFT和DPO之后的67%,番茄酱从72%下降到6%. OLMo 3.1 32B是SFT的例外. 已经变了
在那里上升,在这些类别和品牌上,DPO也加入其中.

blocks.en:
Table 4: Census Choose: how far “Choose” moves the odds toward the panel’s Choose answer, relative to “Name” (nats),
over the 23 categories where the two differ. Last column: the SFT-to-DPO change, 90% interval.
blocks.zh:
表4:普查选择:相对于 " 姓名 " (nats)而言, " 选择 " 使小组选择答案的概率达到多大程度。
超过两者不同的23个类别。 最后一列:SFT对DPO的更改,间隔90%.

blocks.en:
Half of OLMo 3’s DPO pairs are judged by an LLM. The other half pair
a response from Qwen 3 32B, as chosen, with one from a much smaller model, as rejected [ 7 ] . Tulu 3’s
pairs are rated by GPT-4o [ 14 ] . In both pipelines other models decide which answer is better, and
the student applies it to situations mostly unrelated to the preference data.
blocks.zh:
OLMo 3的DPO配对的一半通过LLM来判断. 另一个半对
由所选的Quen 3 32B的回复,其中有一个来自更小的模型,被否决 [7]. 图卢3级
配对由GPT-4o [14] 评分. 在这两个管道中,其他模型决定哪个答案更好,以及
学生将其应用于与偏好数据基本无关的情况。

blocks.en:
Tulu 3’s preference data has one judge. Answers from a pool of 22 models are rated by
GPT-4o [ 14 ] , and the top-rated answer becomes the chosen one. Where GPT-4o recommends a different
brand from Tulu’s own base-model favourite, we give each stage a list with both, in both orders. DPO moves the pick
toward GPT-4o’s brand, by 8 points (90% interval 2 to 14). The GPT-4o we query is the current release, not the
2024-08-06 snapshot that labelled Tulu’s data, so its brands approximate the judge’s. OLMo 3’s data has no single teacher, so the test applies
to Tulu only (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh:
Tulu 3 的偏好数据有一位法官。 22个模型的回答被评为
GPT-4o [14],最高评分的答案成为被选中的答案. GPT-4o 建议不同
我们给每个舞台列表, DPO 移动选择
向GPT-4o品牌进发8分(90%间隔2到14分). 我们查询的GPT-4o是当前发布的,而不是
2024-08-06 贴有标签的快照 Tulu的数据, OLMo 3的数据没有单一的老师,所以测试适用
仅至图卢(附录B ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Language models name the market leader but recommend a different brand, and different models agree on which one. On
open pipelines the recommended brand is present after pretraining, attached to advice. SFT mostly leaves the pick
unchanged.
DPO moves the model to the recommended brand, using preference data that contains almost no brands.
blocks.zh:
语言模型命名市场领袖但推荐不同的品牌,不同的模型同意哪个品牌. 打开
推荐品牌经过预训后,附在咨询意见之后,即为存在。 SFT 大多是离开采摘
不变。
DPO将模型移动到推荐品牌,使用包含几乎没有品牌的偏好数据.

blocks.en:
DPO moves the model toward a second set of associations that we can only partly describe. The Picked brands include
specialist and enthusiast brands, such as Brooks, Sierra Nevada and Stumptown, independent or privacy-minded ones,
such as DuckDuckGo, Signal and Firefox, and value or premium brands chosen for quality, such as Aldi, Uniqlo, Hermès
and Seiko. Underneath these switches is an implicit notion of taste that we can only speculate about for now. In Tulu,
the pick moves toward the brand its judge model would recommend. That is a partial answer, because the preference data
contains almost no examples of these comparisons.
blocks.zh:
DPO将模式推向第二组协会,我们只能部分描述。 Picked品牌包括:
专业和爱好者品牌,如布鲁克斯、内华达山和斯坦普敦,独立或有隐私意识的品牌,
例如DuckDuckGo、Signal和Firefox,以及为质量选择的价值或溢价品牌,例如Aldi、Uniqlo、Hermès
还有濑子 这些开关下面是一个隐含的口味概念,我们现在只能猜测。 在图鲁
选手向着品牌移动 法官模式会推荐。 这是一个部分答案,因为偏好数据
这些比较几乎没有实例。

blocks.en:
For a brand, this makes a recommendation hard to earn directly. It depends less on what a model knows about the brand
and more on whether the brand fits this notion of taste. In marketing terms this is a question of brand associations
and positioning [ 13 , 1 ] . How a brand can create
these associations for itself is a question for future work.
blocks.zh:
对于一个品牌来说,这使得一个建议很难直接赚取. 更不看模特儿知道什么
更多关于品牌是否适合 这种口味的概念。 在营销方面,这是一个品牌协会的问题
和定位 [13, 1]. 如何创造品牌
这些协会本身是未来工作的一个问题。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Our questions are short and carry no personal context. Measures on short prompts can fail to predict realistic use [ 16 ] . Audits of production assistants measure real requests and complement this work.
blocks.zh: 我们的问题很短,没有个人背景。 关于短促反应的措施可能无法预测实际用途[16]。 对生产助理的审计衡量实际要求并补充这项工作。

blocks.en:
The three staged pipelines come from one lab and share much of their recipe. The panel shows the same switch across
102 served models from every major lab, so the outcome holds beyond these pipelines even though the route is shown
only on them. Nemotron agrees from base to final but has no intermediate stages. The 32B and Nemotron run at 8-bit
precision. For OLMo 3 7B, sampled picks place the change at RL (Appendix B ). The panel is a dated
specimen of models as served between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-10.
blocks.zh:
三个阶段的管道来自一个实验室,并分享了大部分的食谱. 面板显示相同的开关
每个大实验室的102个服务型号,所以结果都超出了这些管道,尽管显示了路线
只有他们。 尼莫特龙同意从基地到最终,但没有中间阶段. 32B和尼莫特龙跑8位
精细。 对于OLMo 3 7B,采样后将变化置于RL(附录B). 面板是一个日期
2026-09-30至2026-10-10年间服役的模型样本。

blocks.en: Note on AI usage
blocks.zh: 关于AI用法的说明

blocks.en:
This work was done with Claude (Opus 5.5), which helped run the probes, build the analysis and
draft the text; the research questions and interpretation are the author’s. Several Claude
models are also subjects of the study.
blocks.zh:
这项工作是与Claude(Opus 5.5)一起完成的,后者帮助运行了探测器,进行了分析,
起草案文;研究问题和解释是作者的。 几个克劳德
模型也是研究的主题。

Rewording Recommend twice, on a 14-model subset, leaves its consensus brand unchanged in 34 to

Sampling picks from the SFT stage’s own lists agrees with the log-probabilities within a
few points everywhere except OLMo 3 7B at DPO (Table 7 ). There, sampled picks do not move until RL.
First-token probabilities and generated answers are known to diverge in tuned models [ 25 ] .

blocks.en:
DPO can concentrate probability on outputs that were already likely [ 20 ] or move it to unrelated ones [ 19 ] . The first would move a model toward
its base runner-up. The base model’s second choice under Name is the panel’s Picked brand in only 2 or 3 of 26
categories, and DPO does not favour the runner-up over the pick.
blocks.zh:
DPO可以将概率集中在已经可能[20]的产出上,或者将其转移到无关的产出[19]. 第一个会把模型推向
它的底部跑动。 品牌下的第二个选择是 26 个中只有 2 个或 3 个的板块
类别,DPO不赞成选手比选手多。
